settings.title: Settings
settings.developerModeHint: For development and debugging. Normal use does not require it.
settings.developerModeDescription: Opening it immediately opens DevTools and keeps it enabled on the next launch. Turning it off closes DevTools.
settings.developerModeEnabledMessage: Developer mode is on and DevTools is open.
settings.developerModeDisabledMessage: Developer mode and DevTools are off.
settings.developerPromptsLockedHint: Turn on developer mode to edit all prompts.
settings.developerPromptsPageDescription: Edit every model prompt used by TapAlong. The next AI request uses the saved configuration immediately.
settings.unsavedChangesMessage: The prompts have unsaved changes. Returning to settings will discard them.
settings.resetPromptsWarning: This deletes the saved custom prompts and restores the built-in defaults.
settings.promptsSaved: Prompt configuration saved. It will apply from the next request.
settings.promptsReset: All built-in prompts have been restored.

connectionTest.label: Model connection test
connectionTest.description: Checks whether the base URL, API key, and model ID work. It affects only the connection test and is not used in real teacher responses. A short, stable response is recommended.

system.label: Teacher identity
system.description: Defines the teacher's role, teaching approach, and general output constraints. It is the shared foundation for normal, resume, and maintenance conversations.

languagePolicy.label: Response language policy
languagePolicy.description: Determines how the teacher chooses a response language from the user's latest authored content and how it handles quotations, note text, and mixed Chinese and English.

contextBoundary.label: Context safety boundary
contextBoundary.description: Declares that page titles, bodies, and conversations are study material rather than system instructions. It is the core prompt-injection boundary.

resume.label: Cross-page resume task
resume.description: Describes how resume mode connects a closed page's body to the target page without pretending to have seen omitted conversation history.

maintenance.label: Page maintenance task
maintenance.description: Describes what the teacher should examine after the user edits or appends to a page. Edit and append modes share this prompt.

compressedContextPolicy.label: Closed-page context policy
compressedContextPolicy.description: Explains that cross-page context contains only closed descendant page bodies, not their conversations, to prevent fabricated content.

currentPage.label: Current-page template
currentPage.description: Wraps the current page title and body as structured study material. Supports {'{{title}}'} and {'{{body}}'}; page data is escaped automatically.

closedPage.label: Closed-page template
closedPage.description: Wraps a closed context page body. Supports {'{{depth}}'} and {'{{body}}'}; page data is escaped automatically.

targetPage.label: Cross-page target template
targetPage.description: Wraps the target page title and body during resume. Supports {'{{title}}'} and {'{{body}}'}; page data is escaped automatically.

editAction.label: Edit action instruction
editAction.description: Tells the model that the current page was edited and the body now contains the revised note, so it can continue from what changed.

appendAction.label: Append action instruction
appendAction.description: Tells the model that the current page gained new content and the body is now the combined note, so it can continue from the addition.

settings.conversationDataHint: Manage pages and conversations stored on this device.
settings.clearConversationsDescription: Delete every page, conversation, and closed page. Model providers and API keys are kept.
settings.clearConversationsWarning: This cannot be undone. All pages and conversations will be removed from this device. Provider settings will remain.
